hero.title: Licensed online consultations tailored to where you live
hero.description: Secure video and messaging-based care across Europe.
hero.seoTitle: Online Doctor Consultations in Europe & Brazil
hero.seoDescription: Speak with a locally-licensed doctor by video in Ireland, Portugal, Spain, Czechia, Romania or Brazil. Medical certificates, referrals and follow-up care.

countryHero.subtitle: Choose a service, select an open time, and speak with licensed clinicians registered with national medical councils across Europe.

sameDay.title: Same-Day Consultation
sameDay.reassure: Choose your language, pick a time — we will assign the right GP.

doctifyReviews.headline: Rated by real patients
doctifyReviews.body: Independent, verified reviews collected by Doctify from patients treated by our clinicians.

team.headline: Will I see
team.body: Every consultation is with someone licensed where you are. No call centres, no rota of strangers — the doctor on screen is the doctor on the profile.

howItWorks.subtitle: From choosing a service to a confirmed appointment — select a clinician, pick a time, and get care from anywhere.
howItWorks.step1Body: Browse GP consultations, specialist referrals, and home-test services. Filter by language, urgency, or price.
howItWorks.step2Body: Select a licensed clinician registered in your country and choose an open appointment slot from their live calendar.
howItWorks.step3Body: Join the consultation from any device. Receive notes or next steps when clinically appropriate after the appointment.

finalCta.body: Browse licensed doctors registered with national medical councils across Europe, then choose an open appointment time where availability is shown.

statsBand.headline: Built for people who shouldn't have to
statsBand.body: Access licensed clinicians through open appointment slots, clear profiles, and service-specific booking steps.
statsBand.stat1Caption: Registered with their local medical council.
statsBand.stat3Caption: Open slots are shown from live doctor calendars.

blog.checkBackSoon: Check back soon for medical guides and service explainers.
blog.readyToSpeak: Ready to speak with a doctor?
blog.bookConsultationBody: Book an online consultation with a locally-registered doctor in your country. Open appointments are shown during booking.
blog.medicalDisclaimer: This article is for information only and is not a substitute for medical advice.
